End-of-life computers

Secure computer collection

Stack of end-of-life Windows 10 machines you don't know what to do with? Saved will securely format and document them before contractually purchasing, collecting, processing, restoring, and reimagining them.

Saved will go on to sell Saved laptops with warranties for a modest fee, with profits redirected to supporting training schemes in resilient technologies.

Request a collection

Low-hum anxiety

Digital dependency audits

Being dependent on the services of trillion-dollar corporations is like being indebted to banks or paying rent to landlords. A low-hum anxiety weighing you down, that reduces your freedom and increases your fear of spiralling costs.

Saved can assess your digital dependency using a formulation to reveal the intangible costs. From there, the targeted adoption of open software and platforms can begin.
